office: Presbyter of the church of Antioch

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 3 Μαρτίου, «Άγιος Θεοδώρητος ο Ιερομάρτυρας, πρεσβύτερος Αντιοχείας», with the rank words and the see left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's second heading for the Julian 8 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Свети свештеномученик Теодорит.“, with the rank word свештеномученик left off and Свети, which is not a rank. The heading gives no epithet and does not name Antioch, which this folder's English name carries and which the body of the entry supplies.

The nominative behind the «Феодорита» of days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 8 марта ст. ст., name page 2207, «Феодорит Антиохийский, пресвитер, сщмч.», with the grade and the rank word left off; the day's own line declines the name and the see, «Сщмч. Феодорита , пресвитера Антиохийского».

feast.note: The Russian and the Serbian both keep him on 8 March where the Greek keeps him on 3 March — five days apart in the menologion, and not the thirteen of the style conversion. His name page 2207 lists this one day and no other.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 8 марта ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Феодорита , пресвитера Антиохийского (361-363).»

attestations.note: The day page prints no hymn under his name: its four hymns are a troparion and a kontakion of Theophylact of Nicomedia and three of the Mother of God before her Kursk-Root icon «Знамение». The line closes «(361-363)», which is the reign of Julian the Apostate and not a year of death.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Θεοδώρητος ο Ιερομάρτυρας, πρεσβύτερος Αντιοχείας»

attestations.note: The page heads him «(; - 361)» and puts him in the years of Julian the Apostate, whose reign it gives as 360 to 363. It names the eparch of the city who arrested him as another Julian, and adds the attribution «κατά τον Σ. Εύστρατιάδη ήταν θείος του Ιουλιανού του Παραβάτη και ήταν προηγουμένως Χριστιανός και αναγνώστης της Εκκλησίας της Αντιόχειας» — according to S. Eustratiades he was the Apostate's uncle, and had formerly been a Christian and a reader of the church of Antioch. It prints the distich «Χωρεῖν ἔχει που τῆς Ἐδὲμ τὸ χωρίον, / Καὶ τὸν Θεοδώρητον ἔνδον τὸν μέγαν», names no relic and gives no hymn. Its etymology block lists three other bearers of the name, among them the fifth-century church writer and the bishop of Vresthena of 1821, and none of them is this man. saint.gr keeps him a second time on 17 Μαΐου, on its own page (https://www.saint.gr/1621/saint.aspx, read 1 October 2026), whose whole body is one sentence — presbyter of the Church of Antioch, martyred in the years of Julian the Apostate, 361 to 363 — with a gloss parting him from the fifth-century writer, a general of Justinian and the bishop of Vresthena of 1821. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and not as a row or a folder.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 21.03.2026 (8. март ст. ст.) — „Свети свештеномученик Теодорит.“

attestations.note: The corpus keeps this folder on the Greek 3 Μαρτίου and the Prologue keeps him on the Julian 8 March. The two are read as one man: a presbyter of the church of Antioch, arrested under Julian the Apostate and killed for refusing to deny Christ, which is the whole of what either page makes him. The Prologue adds the Golden Church that Constantine built, the treasurership, the plundering by the emperor's uncle of the same name, and the deaths of the two who had a hand in it. It dates the beheading 362 where this folder holds saint.gr's 361; one year apart, and the sourced year was not written over. The entry also names a Felix as the judge's helper, who dies of a flow of blood at the mouth; the corpus's `felix-8-march` is a martyr the other calendars keep on this menologion day and is plainly not that man, so no row and no relation was made for him.

death.note: saint.gr heads him «Αγιος Θεοδωρητος ο Ιερομαρτυρας, Πρεσβυτερος Αντιοχειας (; - 361)». The body gives no year of its own, only the reign: «στα δύσκολα χρόνια του αυτοκράτορα Ιουλιανού του Παραβάτη (360 - 363 μ.Χ.)», which the year sits inside. No year of birth is given.
